generation.mode: single built-in image_gen whole-canvas edit with edit-target.jpg first and the NinjaOne seed canon second as reference only

lightingIsotropy.metric: 36-bin full-angle land-luminance-gradient magnitude peak divided by the uniform-bin mean; final water-mask pixels and immediate neighbours excluded and gradients below 12 luminance units excluded
lightingIsotropy.visualCheck: No whole-cell cast-shadow field is obvious, but pale bench tops and consistently darker column faces violate the literal equal-value-on-every-side rule.

buildableVsSteepFraction.basis: manual full-frame screen-space estimate as fractions of non-water land at native source resolution
buildableVsSteepFraction.method: Broad coherent bench treads and level shelves count as buildable; exposed column faces and sharp scarps count as steep; talus, rubble, vegetation, carvings and transition margins make up the remainder.
buildableVsSteepFraction.limitation: Screen-space visual estimate with approximate uncertainty of plus or minus 0.08 per fraction, not an elevation-derived slope measurement.

crown.method: Full-frame native-resolution census of all 24 discernible conifer crowns, including saplings and clipped edge crowns, corroborated with a dark-foliage component overlay; median outer foliage-envelope width 24.5 source pixels scaled by 2560/1254 and converted at 0.048 m per final pixel.

waterMask.encoding: opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels; binary alpha
waterMask.method: Native-resolution bank-to-bank span traces of all four visible water components: inherited west-edge water, the fall and runoff, the tarn, and the south-edge stream. Traces include pale wash, ripple highlights, reflections, spray and water between shore stones; the binary overlay was inspected over the raw source.

runeChain.visualRead: The nearest dark incision remains displaced at both outer handoffs, merges visually with bench-foot and wall lines, and meets the west fall system instead of reading as one independent edge-to-edge slot.

refusalReasons: The generated south stream exits at approximately 42.6 percent along the edge instead of the measured 29 percent handoff, so it would break the neighboring stream.
The rune chain is not a distinct continuous dry slot at the registered west and east handoffs; it is displaced, follows or merges with bench geometry, and meets the west fall system.
The plateau tarn is approximately 13.5 metres across rather than about 30 metres.
The wind arch is approximately 6.5 metres across rather than about 12 metres and is not one of the rune groove crossings.
Repeated pale rock tops and darker vertical column faces violate the strict equal-value neutral-lighting rule.
The fall is not separated from the rune-like incision by the required 15 metres.
